# Deepu Siva Private Limited

> Deepu Siva Private Limited provides industrial engineering, steel/metal fabrication, PEB and structural solutions, solar structures, solar installation support, and industrial roofing services in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

- Primary language: English (India)

## Services
- Industrial Engineering — practical engineering support for industrial structures, fabrication and applications.
- Metal Fabrication — custom steel fabrication for industrial, commercial and project-specific requirements.
- PEB & Industrial Structures — pre-engineered buildings, sheds, warehouses and supporting structural systems.
- Solar Structures — engineered steel mounting structures and support systems for solar applications.
- Solar Installation — rooftop and ground-mounted solar installation support.
- Industrial Roofing — roofing and enclosure solutions for factories, warehouses and commercial facilities.

## Project workflow
1. Discover the requirement, site and objective.
2. Engineer the practical solution and scope.
3. Fabricate the required components.
4. Coordinate delivery and logistics.
5. Install or erect at site.
6. Complete the agreed scope and handover.
